content.short: Swell is a liquid restaking protocol and L2 on Ethereum providing yield-bearing assets via swETH and rswETH.
content.description: Swell Network is a leading decentralized restaking ecosystem designed to maximize rewards for Ethereum participants while maintaining capital liquidity. The platform features swETH, a premier liquid staking derivative, and rswETH, a highly composable liquid restaking token that allows users to simultaneously earn Ethereum staking rewards and additional yields from Actively Validated Services (AVS) on EigenLayer and Symbiotic. Swell has also launched its own 'restaked rollup' L2 to serve as a primary hub for restaking yields. Swell focuses on providing a secure environment for all stakers.
content.meta: Swell Network provides liquid restaking derivatives and a restaked Layer 2 hub for Ethereum. Discover Swell on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
